plain_english_policy: Restrict financial penalties for medical professionals in malpractice cases

effects.rationale: Limiting punitive damages reduces the severity of financial penalties for malpractice, effectively reducing punitive consequences for medical professionals.

By capping punitive damages, this option may discourage frivolous lawsuits and reduce legal barriers to healthcare providers, but it also limits compensation for victims of malpractice, indirectly restricting access to justice.
